title: Unified Golden Dataset Registry and Versioned Promptset ACLs
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem statement: Our current golden promptsets and evaluation bundles are scattered across GDrive and ad-hoc repos, with inconsistent metadata, no strong access controls, and no immutable versioning tied to eval gating. That creates breakage during model/config rollouts and blocks safe automated regression detection.

Goal: Build a single Golden Dataset Registry (GDR) that stores curated promptsets and test bundles with canonical metadata, immutable snapshot IDs, fine-grained ACLs, and versioned promotion flows. Tie the registry to the eval pipeline so that model/config changes can be automatically evaluated against pinned snapshots or a selectable golden baseline. Provide Console UX and API endpoints for dataset authors, reviewers, and SREs.

Scope (MVP):
- Registry storage model (immutable snapshot IDs, human-friendly aliases, semantic version tags).
- Per-dataset RBAC (owner, maintainer, reviewer, read-only) enforced via Console and API.
- Metadata schema: name, description, model_compatibility, expected_metrics, creation_audit, change_log, tags, retention_policy.
- Integration with eval pipeline: ability to pin snapshot ID in a rollout and automatically run the gating eval when a model/config change is proposed.
- Console pages: dataset listing, dataset detail with version history, create/upload flow, and ACL management modal.
- Audit log and basic retention policy enforcement (soft-delete + purge windows).

Success metrics:
- Reduce eval gating manual pain: 80% of model rollouts use pinned golden datasets within 6 weeks of launch.
- Decrease post-rollout regressions attributable to outdated promptsets by 75% in Q2 after rollout.
- 95% of datasets have required metadata fields filled at creation.

Acceptance criteria:
1) Backend: Registry API exists with create/list/get/snapshot/list-snapshots/pin endpoints; snapshots are immutable and have stable IDs.
2) RBAC: Console and API enforce ACLs; owners can add reviewers and maintainers.
3) Eval integration: When a rollout references a pinned snapshot, the gated eval job runs automatically and blocks rollout if metrics regress beyond thresholds.
4) UX: Console flows for dataset creation and ACL edits are usable; design review signed off.
5) Audit & logs: Every dataset creation, snapshot, ACL change emits an audit event ingested by our logging pipeline.

Non-goals (MVP exclusions):
- Complex dataset diff/merge tooling; we'll start with snapshot-level diffs and manual guidance.
- Full multi-tenant discovery UI beyond search and tags — future phase.

Migration & rollout plan:
Phase 1 (2 sprints) - API + immutable snapshots + metadata schema and migration script to import canonical sets from Drive.
Phase 2 (1 sprint) - RBAC integration and Console ACL modal + security review.
Phase 3 (2 sprints) - Eval gating integration, rollout automation, dashboards for dataset usage and regressions.

Risks & mitigations:
- RBAC complexity could slow adoption: mitigation is to ship a simple owner/maintainer/reviewer/read role model first.
- Migration errors could lead to inconsistent baselines: create a validation job and require manual verification step for imported snapshots.
- Storage cost for immutable snapshots: we will store pointers to canonical promptfiles and compress older snapshots; evaluate cold storage after MVP.
